hooks.name: Session Start — Project Status
hooks.description: Reads tasks.md at session start and prints a concise progress summary

action.prompt:
At the start of this session, read `.kiro/specs/aeroicing-watch/tasks.md` and produce a brief project status report so the agent knows exactly where work left off.

Parse all `[x]` and `[ ]` items. Output:

---
## AeroIcing Watch — Session Start Status

**Progress:** X / Y tasks (N%)
**Active phase:** Phase N — [name]
**Last completed task:** [task id and short description, or "none yet"]
**Next task to implement:** [task id and short description]

**Blockers / notes from tasks.md:** [any inline notes near unchecked tasks, or "none"]
---

Keep it under 15 lines. This is an orientation summary, not a full report.
